2. This revision has been filed against 
the judgment and order dated 01.08.2025 
passed by the learned Principal Judge, 
Family Court, Dehradun in Criminal Case 
No.473 of 2021, Sulochana Malasi Vs. JC 
38069Y Subedar Major Ganesh Chandra 
Malasi, whereby, the application filed by 
the revisionist-wife under Section 125 
Cr.P.C. for maintenance was partly 
allowed and the respondent-husband was 
directed to pay Rs.7,000/- per month to 
the revisionist-wife from filing of that 
application, on 10th day of every month.
3. Issue notice to respondent, returnable 
within four weeks.
4. Steps to be taken within two weeks.
